Aldehyde dehydrogenase (no Ensembl 1:1 ortholog); paper "pavement cell" marker, pct 0.39 vs 0.04, in situ epidermal signal (Fig 5C). Also DE in the rejected c6 and c14 (Zang et al. 2024 Plant Physiol Table S13, S18).

Secreted peptide from meristemoids/GMCs that limits stomatal entry (ortholog AT1G34245); c1 0.61, c9 0.28, c3 0.21. Paper lists it as a guard-cell marker; it marks the earlier lineage (Zang et al. 2024 Plant Physiol Table S3).

TOO MANY MOUTHS receptor of the stomatal lineage per paper symbol; Ensembl gives no 1:1 ortholog (UniProt LRR protein), so orthology unconfirmed; c1 0.21 vs <=0.04 (Zang et al. 2024 Plant Physiol Table S3).

SPEECHLESS per paper symbol (UniProt bHLH; orthology not confirmed in Ensembl); barely detected, c1 0.04 vs 0 elsewhere (Zang et al. 2024 Plant Physiol Table S3). Use only for enrichment within epidermal clusters.

Guard-cell-specific MYB regulating stomatal opening (ortholog AT1G08810; UniProt MYB60); weakly detected, c1 0.08, c6 0.06; guard subcluster 1-4 has only ~10-30 cells (Zang et al. 2024 Plant Physiol Table S3).
Second MYB60 gene (UniProt MYB60); c1 0.10, c6 0.05 (Zang et al. 2024 Plant Physiol Table S3). Added at collation.
Guard-cell anion channel QUAC1 (ortholog AT4G17970); barely detected (c1 0.02) (Zang et al. 2024 Plant Physiol Table S3).
CP29 antenna protein; mesophyll in situ (Fig 1C); high in every cluster (ambient), lowest in c1/c5/c12, so use by relative level (Zang et al. 2024 Plant Physiol Table S3, S18).
Rubisco small subunit (RBCS1A/1B group); 126-193 in mesophyll clusters vs 14-30 in c1/c5/c12; ambient in protoplast data (Zang et al. 2024 Plant Physiol Table S3).
Rubisco small subunit (RBCS1A/1B group); 95-152 in mesophyll clusters vs 16-37 in c1/c5/c10/c12 (Zang et al. 2024 Plant Physiol Table S3).

RRM protein; paper "palisade" marker (pct 0.39 vs 0.05), but the in situ (Fig 5C) shows mesophyll without palisade restriction, so assigned to Mesophyll (Zang et al. 2024 Plant Physiol Table S13, S18).
Germin-like protein; paper "spongy" marker (pct 0.80 vs 0.32); spongy/palisade split unsupported, so assigned to Mesophyll (Zang et al. 2024 Plant Physiol Table S13).

SCARECROW, BS identity in Arabidopsis leaves (ortholog AT3G54220). CONFLICT: not enriched in the paper bundle-sheath cluster c7 (0.11); highest in dividing c11 (0.71). Test in data; no validated cassava BS marker (Zang et al. 2024 Plant Physiol Table S3).
WOX4, procambium/cambium proliferation (no Ensembl 1:1 ortholog; UniProt homeobox); c5 0.45 vs <=0.10. c5 merges procambium and xylem/phloem precursors (Zang et al. 2024 Plant Physiol Table S3).
PXY/TDR receptor of the TDIF-WOX4 pathway (ortholog AT5G61480); c5 0.65 vs <=0.21 (Zang et al. 2024 Plant Physiol Table S3).
Second TDR/PXY gene per paper (UniProt kinase; orthology unconfirmed); c5 0.37 vs <=0.09 (Zang et al. 2024 Plant Physiol Table S3). Added at collation.

ATHB-8 per paper symbol, HD-ZIP III of procambium/xylem precursors; Ensembl gives no ortholog (UniProt uncharacterized), so orthology unconfirmed; c5 0.57 but c12 0.43, c9 0.36 (Zang et al. 2024 Plant Physiol Table S3).
DOF of cambium/phloem formation (ortholog AT5G62940); c5 0.84 vs <=0.08 (Zang et al. 2024 Plant Physiol Table S3). Paper calls it phloem.
PEAR-type DOF of procambial/phloem-pole proliferation (no Ensembl 1:1; UniProt Dof); c5 1.13 vs <=0.17 (Zang et al. 2024 Plant Physiol Table S3).

Second ACL5 ortholog (AT5G19530); c5 1.04 vs <=0.16 (Zang et al. 2024 Plant Physiol Table S3).
